front: Single use: cast augury from the scroll at rank 2 (must be on your spell list). Ask about the results of a course of action; predicts up to 30 minutes ahead: good, bad, mixed or nothing.
back:
Scroll: cast the spell from it at rank 2 (it must be on your spell list); then it's used up.
The GM reveals a best guess about results up to 30 minutes ahead: good, bad, mixed (a mix of good and bad) or nothing (nothing particularly good or bad).
The GM rolls a secret DC 6 flat check; on a failure the result is always "nothing", so you can't tell whether "nothing" is accurate.
Asking about the same topic with another augury uses the first casting's secret roll. If circumstances change, a different result is possible.
